novelty_flags.label: Theorems 2–3 / related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: BhattacharyaNabiShpitser2022 is a close published ADMG/fixing efficiency-and-estimation comparator omitted from related_work; it does not subsume true Verma-constraint completeness, but its mb-shielded boundary must be stated.

soundness_flags.label: def:indexed-sieve-estimator and thm:indexed-projector-limit
soundness_flags.one_line: As defined, D0hat retains the -Psi_nu(P_n) centering after nuisance substitution and is generally not in H_n, yet Qhat is an H_n projector; moreover Psi_nu(Phat) is undefined when Phat is only a nuisance collection.

soundness_flags.label: ass:outcome-moment
soundness_flags.one_line: Y is a coordinate of O, whose factor is finite or compact Euclidean, so Y is bounded and the stated 2+eta moment follows automatically.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:joint-fixing-completeness
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Completeness is claimed only on semantics-aligned laminar fixing forests and bounded Sobolev charts, not on arbitrary nested-Markov ADMGs or merely L2-dominated laws.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Full tangent/orthocomplement equality is conditional on (G,P,s) belonging to C_LFF^{s,+}.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:indexed-projector-limit
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Root-n inference is limited to sequences satisfying the displayed nuisance-product, sieve, angle, projector, envelope, and variance conditions.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The Wald conclusion holds conditionally over the stated triangular sequence regime, including only permitted rates of q_n→1 and kappa_n→0.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 4, Proposition 3 and the immediately following “Conjectured completeness under multiple constraints” remark; Appendix S4.2, “Sequential Verma Constraints.”
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 3 gives a subspace inclusion for multiple constraints and the following remark conjectures equality; Appendix S4.2 gives a sequential two-Verma example rather than a general completeness theorem.
The paper defines nested-Markov models for ADMGs through fixing-derived kernel conditional independences, ordered-local/global properties, and recursive factorization.

The paper derives efficient estimators for mb-shielded ADMGs, explicitly identifies arbitrary equality/Verma-constraint tangent-space projection as a remaining extension, and is therefore a close but non-subsuming comparator.
The paper derives orthocomplement expressions for general Markov models defined solely by conditional-independence restrictions, not post-fixing nested-Markov equalities.
